digest.component_or_area: LLM agent tool management / step limiting
propositions: tool_step_limit filtering via .filtered() empties toolsets mid-run, causing Bedrock/Anthropic to reject requests containing toolUse history without toolConfig, raising ValidationException 400
pydantic-ai's tool_choice='none' mapping omits toolConfig entirely, triggering the same provider constraint violation when run history contains tool_use blocks
the constraint violation is misinterpreted as LLMUnavailableError, preventing graceful landing of runs that exceed step limits
FunctionModel unit tests mask the provider protocol constraint because they accept tools-less requests over tool_use history, unlike real Bedrock/Anthropic endpoints
steering via synthetic tool results keeps tool definitions advertised throughout the run, satisfying provider constraints while forcing model convergence at the step limit
